mistakes.product: Cathay Pacific round-trip premium-cabin fare, Da Nang (Vietnam) to New York
mistakes.cause: online ticketing error (no technical cause given)
mistakes.outcome: Honored: Cathay said it would let ticket holders fly. Sources disagree on whether $675 was the business or the first-class fare.
mistakes.quote: return fares of as low as $675 from Da Nang in Vietnam to New York ... the same journey cost around $16,000

mistakes.product: ANA first-class round trip, Jakarta to Aruba via Tokyo and New York
mistakes.cause: wrong currency: currency conversion error on ANA's Vietnam website
mistakes.outcome: ANA first said it would honor, then cancelled and fully refunded the itineraries.
mistakes.quote: A Hong Kong resident paid $890 for a $16,300 first class ticket ... 'ANA will cancel and fully refund all itineraries.'

mistakes.product: Qantas first-class round trip, Sydney to Los Angeles
mistakes.cause: software glitch: coding error in the booking system (Qantas statement)
mistakes.outcome: Not honored in first class; about 300 buyers were rebooked into business class at the price paid, or refunded. Original A$20,000 and A$5,000, converted at about 0.67 USD per AUD (Aug 2024).
mistakes.quote: the airline had first class fares of around $5,000 AUD roundtrip ... the normal published fare of ~$20,000 AUD

mistakes.product: Canon EOS R8 camera with RF 24-105mm lens bundle
mistakes.cause: column swap: quantity and price fields swapped (35 units at CHF 1,299 became 1,299 units at CHF 35)
mistakes.outcome: About 1,300 orders cancelled. Original CHF 1,299 and CHF 35, converted at about 1.24 USD per CHF (Aug 2025).
mistakes.quote: Statt 35 Kameras zu je 1299 Franken haben wir 1299 Stück zu je 35 Franken verkauft (Instead of 35 cameras at 1299 francs each, we sold 1299 units at 35 francs each)

mistakes.cause: unknown (MediaWorld called it a glaring technical price error)
mistakes.outcome: Orders were charged and delivered; 11 days later buyers were asked to pay 619 euros more (after a 150 euro discount) or return the iPad. Original 879 euros list and 15 euros, converted at about 1.155 USD per EUR (Nov 2025).
mistakes.quote: un prezzo platealmente inferiore rispetto agli 879 euro di listino (a price blatantly lower than the 879-euro list price) ... 15 euro

mistakes.cause: decimal slip (decimal point entered in the wrong place)

mistakes.cause: data-entry error (intended sale price NT$4,800 / US$146.46, listed NT$500)

mistakes.quote: NT$500 (US$15.26) ... the NT$4,800 (US$146.46) price it should have given ... the monitors cost NT$7,500 (US$228.84)

mistakes.product: United Airlines first-class round trip, London to Newark
